test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘M & N’ means ‘M is the wife of N’,

‘M @ N’ means ‘M is the son of N’,

‘M $ N’ means ‘M is the mother of N’.

Based on the above, how is R related to O if ‘N $ O @ P @ Q & R’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 M is

 &

Given: N $ O @ P @ Q & R

N $ O → N is the mother of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f63da512a6ecaaa8d9077a62a5aba2008a616cf454151937dff10c9ef67122ba.png] 

O @ P → O is the son of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b678af41f12ba6853471a2b6d78f782a281cb4be0fc45a2a3bb8ec808615cfb0.png] 

P @ Q → P is the son of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98720da9cee393243dfae353db46dd1175b3e9d7d78f562c96db9998faace02c.png] 

Q & R → Q is the wife of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/771fed9fef513733316490db064b529a4514c6bfae2828a9cdf26adc4245e008.png] 

Thus, R is O's parental grandfather or father's father.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
